In the Toymaker's Main Workshop, soft directional sunlight streams through high paned windows over racks of hardwood lumber, iron vises, and fragrant sawdust-covered floors.

Elias Thorne, an elderly master toymaker with a weathered kindly face, thinning white hair, and round wireframe spectacles, wears a green canvas work apron over a cream flannel shirt, worn brown leather boots, and has a brass caliper tucked into his chest pocket. Ten-year-old Toby Thorne, with unruly curly auburn hair and freckled cheeks, wears a yellow hoodie, denim overalls, blue high-top sneakers, and a backwards brown newsboy cap. Elias unrolls blueprints across the workbench holding a wooden pencil, while Toby rests his hands excitedly on the crate rim to hear the plan.

shots.prompt:
Natural afternoon light envelops the open Sunshine Playroom, illuminating the central railway table surrounded by rainbow-painted walls.

Elias Thorne, kindly and smiling in his grey tweed vest and wireframe spectacles, stands beside freckle-faced Toby Thorne in his yellow hoodie and overalls. The Hospital Station Depot sits proudly completed at the center of the wooden track layout. Toby reaches up and happily pulls the tiny tower bell cord twice, letting out a sharp cheerful chime, while Elias places an affectionate arm across the boy's shoulder to declare the railway officially open.

A warm wide shot slowly pulls backward through the playroom as smiling children gather in wonder around the display.
